note: Holdout for Q&A reliability (batch 3). Written before any retrieval change in this batch. The first measurement was taken blind (answers 15/19, abstention 9/12, refusal 2/3 after the h19 swap). After that, five items whose failures showed general gaps were fixed (see their notes), so those five are no longer blind. Same author as the fixes. Existing gold files in src/data are untouched. Batch 4: h08, h12 and h19 were the three questions named in the batch-4 task (a deposit paraphrase, a 'skip German cover' paraphrase and the library-card false positive), so they were investigated directly and are exposed. They are fixed by general changes (vocabulary, a section-title bonus for document questions, and an incidental-single-match abstention) and were not used to choose any parameter value.
